body.name: \mathsf{RA}
body.def: \(\mathsf{RA}\) holds when, for every \(j\in\mathcal J\), \(b_j<g_j\le t_j<q_j\), the three edges \((g_j,b_j),(q_j,b_j),(q_j,t_j)\) belong to \(\mathcal E_0\), and \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}(G=q_j)>0\).
body.role: Rectangular risk-set anchoring condition for the zero-anticipation sanity reduction.
